thread:
maria_support: Heads-up — we've got multiple reports that some dashboard panels go completely empty after a user does an SSO reauth. They have region=ap-south, model=redwood-3b, version=v2 selected but charts show zero rows.

kevin_product: Thanks — any customer IDs or orgs?

maria_support: Two customers: org-842 and org-199. Both hit it after their session re-auth (OKTA). Happens intermittently, not all users. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/sha1/xxx.png

olga_eng: Do we see any errors in the console query layer? Can you paste the raw query the UI generated?

maria_support: Copied from the browser devtools network tab: 
```
GET /api/analytics/query?range=7d&region=ap-south&model=redwood-3b&version=v2&group_by=route
Authorization: Bearer <redacted-token>
```
Response 200 but payload empty: `{ "rows": [], "meta": {"interval": "1h"}}`

sam_oncall: If response is 200 with empty rows, either backend filtered them out (region/model/version mismatch) or the token scoping filtered org data. Any 403s around the time?

maria_support: No 403s. For org-842 we do see API 200s around 10:12:03 but metrics show zero for the filters. Raw event logs still exist for that timeframe when queried without filters.

olga_eng: Repro steps request: 1) Login via SSO 2) Open console -> Analytics -> Models view 3) Set region=ap-south + model + version 4) Observe panels empty 5) Hard refresh restores data sometimes. Can someone try from a fresh incognito?

kevin_product: Repro'ed in incognito for org-199. After SSO reauth (login flow), panels empty until I click 'Reset filters' and reapply. Looks like the UI applies a stale model alias when session token rotates.

maria_support: Also customer reports that billing counts for the same time window show normal numbers in Billing -> Usage, so events exist server-side. It's specific to the analytics aggregation path.

olga_eng: Two tracks: 1) UI might send an alias instead of canonical model id after token refresh. 2) Backend filter normalization may be dropping requests when token has different 'org_scope' claim. I'll poke logs for query normalization and token claims.

metrics-bot: Query normalization trace available: trace_id=trc_9a8, filter_normalize: model_alias_lookup->miss for alias "r3b" at 2024-06-21T10:11:58Z

sam_oncall: If alias lookup misses, the routed query becomes an empty predicate. Workaround: ask customer to toggle model dropdown or append `&model=redwood-3b` explicitly in query params (which forces canonical id).

maria_support: Sent workaround and asked for HAR file. Customer provided HAR and OKTA logs. Sharing in #support-attachments.

olga_eng: From HAR: UI sometimes sends `model=r3b` (short alias) immediately after SSO flow; when Authorization header changes, backend alias cache lookup fails for a fraction of a second due to our per-org cache key. We need to guard alias resolution to fall back to unhashed global alias mapping.

kevin_product: UX ask — can we show a small banner when filters return empty because normalization failed? "Filters applied but no data returned — try Reset filters".

sam_oncall: Fix plan: (A) quick rollback: ensure alias resolution uses global fallback (hotfix in eng-runtime) — low risk; (B) medium: adjust client to re-resolve model ids after reauth; (C) long: remove per-request window where alias cache can be empty. I'll open a P0 SR and link here.

maria_support: Customer is OK with workaround for now. They're on a Dedicated plan, want ETA.

olga_eng: ETA for hotfix: ~2 hours to push canary to staging and 4 hours to roll to prod if no regression. I'll coordinate with sam.

sam_oncall: Kicking deploy. deploy-bot: starting canary for release eng-runtime@2024.6.21-hotfix (meta: alias-cache-fallback).

metrics-bot: Canary started. Monitoring panels for ap-south model queries for increased success rate.

kevin_product: Also confirm: this bug can cause analytics to undercount model-version slices but not billing or raw events. Good to note for customer comms.

maria_support: Noted. I'll update the customers with ETA and temporary steps (toggle model dropdown / reset filters).

olga_eng: After canary looks good, I'll merge the fallback into mainline and add a unit test for alias cache empty-state.

sam_oncall: last check: canary metrics show panels repopulating after hotfix. Marking thread resolved pending prod rollout.

maria_support: Thanks everyone, closing after prod rollout and confirmation from both customers. :tada:
